name: imgradient3
expr: [Gmag, Gaz, Gel] = imgradient3(V); [Gx, Gy, Gz] = imgradientxyz(V); [Gmag2, Gaz2, Gel2] = imgradient3(Gx, Gy, Gz); Gmag1 = imgradient3(V); [Gmp, Gap, Gep] = imgradient3(V, 'prewitt'); r1 = Gmag(2,2,2); r2 = Gaz(2,2,2); r3 = Gel(2,2,2); r4 = Gmag1(2,2,2); r5 = Gmag2(2,2,2); r6 = Gaz2(2,2,2); r7 = Gel2(2,2,2); r8 = Gmp(2,2,2);
comment: Sig: [Gmag,Gaz,Gel] = imgradient3(V,method) | imgradient3(Gx,Gy,Gz). Branches: V+method (sobel/prewitt/central/intermediate via imgradientxyz then polar) + (Gx,Gy,Gz) from-grads path + single-output Gmag. Image namespace 2026-05-27.
